scope: Real source; controlled DOM and declared policy/storage failures/prepared final verdicts. No new art or canon claim.

checks.name: Malformed bindings repair to usable defaults without modifying their input
Valid individual remaps survive and missing actions inherit defaults
Reserved, oversized and duplicate codes cannot silently disable another action
Malformed conclusion objects normalize before a scene may be published
Valid history survives and unknown ids/dates cannot enter the repaired ledger
Finisher settings reject infinite duration and preserve valid choices
Gamepad denial is contained once, then optional retry can recover it
Absent API, sparse arrays and disconnected or malformed gamepads remain safe
Malformed JSON and unavailable storage report fallback without any write
Pause Tab stays in its menu; Enter and Space retain native button activation
Techniques Tab and Shift+Tab move inside the modal and Escape restores the arena
A modal opened from pause returns to pause rather than restarting combat
F2 uses its own focus sequence and guarded browser modifiers cannot fire attacks
Denied gamepad cannot leave a half-started controller and keyboard still moves
Corrupt persisted mappings load repaired controls without deleting campaign data
Corrupt done:null no longer throws after scene creation and credit is not duplicated
Storage write refusal keeps a valid single conclusion in memory and reports the limit
Directly damaged in-memory history is repaired before changing the conclusion window
Persisted page lifecycle retains one useful audio host and one paused render loop
Discarded page disposes audio permanently instead of leaking its context
Natural full-health CPU end advances victory to outro without advancing combat or replay
Final sequence pauses, steps by one tick, resumes and has a bounded duration
Replay seek/restart resets only presentation and a rejected import preserves both states
Focus loss freezes final presentation, and a partial recording never becomes a final sequence
Audio parking suspends rather than disposes, preserves volumes and can unlock again
All fighter definitions, art and stage assets remain byte-identical to R8
